text:
Samir: Quick post-all-hands thread to answer the hiring/org questions folks asked.
Priya: Thanks. Are we doing a hiring freeze or just reshuffling priorities?
Samir: Not a freeze. Short story: 60-day pause on low-priority reqs, refocus budget on infra, runtime, SRE, and core model-serving roles. Revenue-impacting reqs still move.
Zoe: For teams expecting headcount next quarter, will existing offers be honored?
Priya: Existing signed offers stand. Open offers under review will be triaged by recruiting+people-ops, case-by-case.
Marcus: How many new slots for eng/platform?
Javi: We'll add 8 HC for eng/platform next quarter (mostly infra/runtime + 1 senior SWE). Manager hires limited unless backfill from internal promotion.
Zoe: Product and growth roles?
Samir: Product roles tied directly to monetization or SLA ownership ok. Growth/support roles need a 2-line justification submitted to people-ops and cc your lead.
Marcus: If my pod loses a req, what's the support for redeploying folks?
Priya: We'll run a 10-business-day internal redeploy window. Managers will propose matches. People can state preferences. Internal mobility prioritized.
Zoe: Any change to promo or comp timelines?
Priya: Promotions continue; comp pool trimmed modestly. We'll prioritize retention and critical market-rate adjustments.
Marcus: Process changes for approvals?
Samir: Slight tweak: fast-path for critical/revenue roles. Others need a quick sync with Priya+Javi. Aim for a 48h turn-around.
Zoe: Exceptions for customer SLA blockers?
Samir: File an exception with product+eng leads and CC me. We'll review and fast-track where justified.
HRBot: Reminder: HR office hours for impacted teams on Tuesday 11am PT.
Javi: We'll publish an updated org map (owners + provisional headcount) by Thursday so managers can plan reorganizations.
Marcus: Recruiters should pause non-strategic postings?
Priya: Yes. Recruiters: pause those and ping people-ops for triage. I'll follow up with teams who have open reqs.
Zoe: Will there be support (e.g., outplacement) if redeploy isn't possible?
Priya: Standard separation policy applies where necessary, plus outplacement support in select cases. We'll do our best to redeploy first.
Samir: Thanks for the quick Qs. Keeping this short so people can reference. If you need an exception or have urgent blockers, post them here or DM Priya/Javi.
AllhandsBot: Recording: Follow-up notes and staffing doc uploaded to team-docs/all-hands/2026-04-staffing-followup.pdf :page_facing_up:
Priya: I'll consolidate exception requests tomorrow and post a summary to #people-ops. Appreciate everyone being flexible. :pray:
